title.en: Plant hormones: auxins, cytokinins, gibberellins, abscisic acid and ethylene

text.en: A seedling on a windowsill bends toward the light. No nerves or muscles do this - chemical messengers called plant hormones do.

Plant hormones (phytohormones) are organic molecules made in very small amounts that control growth, physiological and biochemical responses.
There are five major classes: auxins, cytokinins, gibberellins, abscisic acid and ethylene; the first three promote growth while abscisic acid and ethylene inhibit it.
Went's experiment on Avena coleoptiles showed that a chemical diffusing from the tip, which he named auxin, causes growth; Darwin had earlier seen the tip influence bending.
Auxins (IAA is natural, 2,4-D synthetic) elongate stems, give apical dominance, induce roots at low concentration, produce seedless fruit (parthenocarpy) and prevent the abscission layer.
Cytokinins promote cell division, delay ageing (Richmond-Lang effect) and encourage lateral buds; they were first isolated from herring sperm and are abundant in coconut milk.
Gibberellins, found by Kurosawa in the Bakanae disease of rice, cause internode elongation and bolting in rosette plants, break dormancy of potato tubers and give parthenocarpic fruits.
Abscisic acid is the stress hormone: it causes abscission, closes stomata in drought, promotes leaf senescence and induces bud dormancy.
Ethylene is a gas that ripens fruits like banana and mango, hastens senescence and forms the abscission zone.

problem.en: Why does a ripe banana placed beside unripe tomatoes in a paper bag ripen them?

text.en: The ripe banana releases ethylene gas.
The gas stays trapped in the bag.
Ethylene triggers ripening of the tomatoes, so they ripen faster than tomatoes kept alone.

prompt.en: Match each hormone to one effect: auxin, cytokinin, gibberellin, abscisic acid, ethylene.

requiredIdeas.en: Auxin: stem elongation or apical dominance

commonMisconceptions.en: Thinking ethylene is a liquid (it is a gas)

points.en: Auxin, cytokinin and gibberellin promote growth; abscisic acid and ethylene inhibit it.
Auxin discovered through Went's experiment; IAA natural, 2,4-D synthetic.
Gibberellins: bolting and seedless fruits; cytokinins delay ageing.
ABA is the stress hormone; ethylene ripens fruits.
